acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By using the Kolegium Sędziów PZSzach .edu app you accept these terms. If you disagree, do not use the app.

service.title: Service description
service.body: Kolegium Sędziów PZSzach .edu is a free learning platform for those preparing for FIDE arbiter exams (NA, FA, IA). We provide a question bank and a practice mode.

account.title: User account
account.body: To use the app you must create an account using Google Sign-In or email and password. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential. You must be at least 16 years old (or have parental consent).

conduct.title: Allowed and prohibited conduct
conduct.body: You may not: copy question content without permission, attempt to access other users' data, use automated scripts (bots), or behave abusively towards other users.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: All questions, educational content, source code and design are protected by copyright. They may be used only for personal learning.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: The app is provided 'as is'. We do not guarantee correctness of question content nor that practicing here is sufficient to pass a real FIDE exam. You use the app at your own risk.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: You can delete your account at any time from the settings page. We may suspend or remove an account in case of terms violations.

changes.title: Changes to terms
changes.body: We may update these terms in the future. We will notify you by email of material changes.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by Polish law. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the courts competent for the app owner.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: We care about your privacy. This policy describes what data we collect and how we use it. Data is processed in accordance with GDPR (EU 2016/679).

data.title: What data we collect
data.body: Email address (for login and communication). Display name (if provided). History of your practice answers (which questions, correct or not, when). Preferences (interface language).

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.body: Providing the service (enabling login, saving learning progress). Technical communication (email verification, password reset). Improving the app (aggregated analysis, no personal identification).

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.body: GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) — contract performance (service provision). GDPR Art. 6(1)(f) — legitimate interest (service quality improvement).

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell or rent your data. Data is stored in Google Firebase (europe-west3 region, Frankfurt). Google is a sub-processor under a DPA.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.body: We keep data as long as your account exists. After you delete your account, data is wiped immediately (except possible system logs, max 30 days).

rights.title: Your rights (GDPR)
rights.body: You have the right to: access your data, rectify it, delete it (in account settings), restrict processing, port it (contact us to receive a copy of your data), object, and lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use only essential cookies (login session, language preference). We do not use tracking or analytical cookies. Details in {cookiesLink}.

security.title: Security
security.body: Data is transmitted over HTTPS. Storage is protected by Firebase Firestore access rules. We use email authentication and Google OAuth with token verification.

children.title: Children
children.body: The app is intended for people aged 16 and older. We do not knowingly collect data from people under this age.

changes.title: Changes to policy
changes.body: We may update this policy. We will notify you by email of material changes.

contact.title: Contact

intro.title: What are cookies
intro.body: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser. They let us remember your session and preferences.

essential.title: Essential
essential.body: Firebase Auth session — required to stay signed in. Language preference (i18n_redirected) — to remember your language choice. These cookies are necessary for the app to function and do not require consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We currently do not use any analytics or marketing cookies. If this changes, we will ask for your consent.

manage.title: How to manage
manage.body: You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but then the app will stop working correctly (no ability to sign in).
